'''''Ocimum kilimandscharicum''''', also known as '''camphor basil''',<ref>{{citation |url=https://npgsweb.ars-grin.gov/gringlobal/taxonomydetail.aspx?id=25484 |title=USDA GRIN Taxonomy |access-date=11 June 2016}}</ref> is a [[Ocimum|basil]] species native to [[Kenya]], [[Tanzania]], [[Uganda]], [[Sudan]], and [[Ethiopia]].<ref name=a>[https://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=136967 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>
